title: Barbara, perchè fuggi?
subtitle: Fiordiligi and Ferrando: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 6, recitative before No. 24
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Barbara, perchè fuggi? as one question; un' aspide and un' idra as two words each; Pàrtiti! with its accent; O ciel, ma tu mi guardi, e poi sospiri?).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 245–246, the accompanied recitative before No. 24 (23 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). An accompanied recitative (strings): Allegro from bar 3, Adagio from bar 13. Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 10 and 19), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. It ends “segue Nr. 24 Arie”; the print's footnote says that by Mozart's autograph the aria is left out and the recitative on p. 253 follows. Playback tempo: Recitativo ♩ = 70, Allegro ♩ = 110, Adagio ♩ = 45, fitted to Jacobs (1:28).
